name: Axora AgentGuard
description: Local guard for AI agents: AgentGuard DeepScan, runtime evaluation, patrol, checkup, and a local audit log.

level.description: Protection level: Strict (`strict`) blocks dangerous and suspicious findings; low-risk commands can still run. Balanced (`balanced`, default) blocks dangerous actions and requires approval for risky ones. Observe (`permissive` in the CLI) blocks critical threats only.
